route.rationale: Two arms of one health check are blind; the fix touches doctor.rs, its tests, and rs-info's payload. The flag count reads 2 on the letter — an existing test changes and its assertion is replaced — but the replaced assertion compares the workspace package version against itself (0.1.0 vs 0.1.0, neither bumped by any release), so it proves nothing and replacing it removes no coverage. De-escalated to small on that evidence; recorded rather than silent.
